title: Replace
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq |S|\leq |T|\leq 50; 1\leq K\leq 50; C_i is a, b,\ldots, or z.; 1\leq |A_i|\leq 50; S, T, and A_i are strings consisting of lowercase English letters.; C_i\neq A_i, regarding C_i as a string of length 1.; All pairs (C_i,A_i) are distinct.
